use keel_ir::Target;
use object::{Object, ObjectSection};
__SELECTED_TEST_MODULES__

fn emit(name: &str, source: &str, sdk: &std::path::Path, out: &std::path::Path) {
    let original = keel_ir::parse(source).unwrap();
    keel_ir::verify_module(&original).unwrap();
    for (tier_name, tier) in [("none", keel_opt::OptimizationTier::None), ("full", keel_opt::OptimizationTier::Full)] {
        let mut module = original.clone();
        keel_opt::optimize_with_tier(&mut module, tier).unwrap();
        keel_ir::verify_module(&module).unwrap();
        let program = keel_codegen::compile_program(&module, Target::Aarch64AppleDarwin).unwrap();
        let macho = keel_asm::assemble_program_object(&program, Default::default()).unwrap();
        let file = object::File::parse(macho.as_slice()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(file.architecture(), object::Architecture::Aarch64);
        let bytes = file.section_by_name("__text").unwrap().size();
        assert!(bytes > 0);
        let system = keel_link::Dylib::from_tbd(&sdk.join("usr/lib/libSystem.tbd"), sdk).unwrap();
        let executable = keel_link::link(&[keel_link::Input { name: "suite.o", bytes: &macho }], keel_link::Options { dylibs: vec![system], ..Default::default() }).unwrap();
        let image = object::File::parse(executable.bytes.as_slice()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(image.kind(), object::ObjectKind::Executable);
        let path = out.join(format!("{name}-{tier_name}"));
        keel_link::write_signed(&executable, &path).unwrap();
        let program = keel_codegen::compile_program(&module, Target::X86_64LinuxGnu).unwrap();
        let elf = keel_asm::x86::assemble_program_object(&program).unwrap();
        let file = object::File::parse(elf.as_slice()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(file.architecture(), object::Architecture::X86_64);
        assert!(file.section_by_name(".text").unwrap().size() > 0);
        println!("native {name}-{tier_name} arm={bytes} x86={}", file.section_by_name(".text").unwrap().size());
    }
}

fn main() {
    __RUN_SELECTED_TESTS__
    println!("upstream selected=__UPSTREAM_TEST_COUNT__");
    let sdk = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("SDKROOT").unwrap());
    let out = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("KEEL_SUITE_OUT").unwrap());
    emit("loop", r#"
func @main() -> i32 {
entry:
 v0 = iconst.i64 0
 v1 = iconst.i64 1
 v2 = iconst.i64 10
 jump header(v0,v0)
header(v3:i64,v4:i64):
 v5 = icmp.slt v3,v2
 brif v5,body,exit
body:
 v6 = iadd v4,v3
 v7 = iadd v3,v1
 jump header(v7,v6)
exit:
 v8 = iconst.i64 45
 v9 = icmp.eq v4,v8
 v10 = iconst.i32 0
 v11 = iconst.i32 1
 v12 = select v9,v10,v11
 return v12
}
"#, &sdk, &out);
    emit("calls", r#"
func @main() -> i32 {
entry:
 v0 = iconst.i64 21
 v1 = call @twice(v0)
 v2 = call @twice(v1)
 v3 = iconst.i64 84
 v4 = icmp.eq v2,v3
 v5 = iconst.i32 0
 v6 = iconst.i32 1
 v7 = select v4,v5,v6
 return v7
}
func @twice(i64) -> i64 {
entry(v0:i64):
 v1 = iadd v0,v0
 return v1
}
"#, &sdk, &out);
    emit("memory", r#"
func @main() -> i32 {
 ss0 = stack_slot 16, align 8
entry:
 v0 = stack_addr ss0
 v1 = iconst.i64 8
 v2 = ptradd v0,v1
 v3 = iconst.i64 17
 v4 = iconst.i64 25
 store v3,v0
 store v4,v2
 v5 = load.i64 v0
 v6 = load.i64 v2
 v7 = iadd v5,v6
 v8 = iconst.i64 42
 v9 = icmp.eq v7,v8
 v10 = iconst.i32 0
 v11 = iconst.i32 1
 v12 = select v9,v10,v11
 return v12
}
"#, &sdk, &out);
    emit("division", r#"
func @main() -> i32 {
entry:
 v0 = iconst.i64 -100
 v1 = iconst.i64 7
 v2 = call @divide(v0,v1)
 v3 = iconst.i64 -16
 v4 = icmp.eq v2,v3
 v5 = iconst.i32 0
 v6 = iconst.i32 1
 v7 = select v4,v5,v6
 return v7
}
func @divide(i64,i64) -> i64 {
entry(v0:i64,v1:i64):
 v2 = sdiv v0,v1
 v3 = srem v0,v1
 v4 = iadd v2,v3
 return v4
}
"#, &sdk, &out);
    emit("indirect", r#"
func @main() -> i32 {
entry:
 v0 = symbol_addr @twice
 v1 = iconst.i64 21
 v2 = call_indirect v0(v1) : (i64) -> i64
 v3 = iconst.i64 42
 v4 = icmp.eq v2,v3
 v5 = iconst.i32 0
 v6 = iconst.i32 1
 v7 = select v4,v5,v6
 return v7
}
func @twice(i64) -> i64 {
entry(v0:i64):
 v1 = iadd v0,v0
 return v1
}
"#, &sdk, &out);
}
